digest.component_or_area: Rebar Janitor remediation (plan-review gate, LLM verification, contributor guidance)
propositions: Contributor and agent guidance must use each contributor's configured real DCO identity, reserving the bot identity for explicitly automated workflows.
Transition guidance must state that --force bypasses all gates including future ones, while ticket-system invariants like the open-children close prohibition remain non-bypassable.
LLM verification must preserve provider-independent parsing and self-healing but must not accept a semantically empty result as a valid review outcome.
Plan review must not yield a clean pass when the ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless the omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant.
ChatGPT-specific guidance must explain safe Rebar use when the repository is a read-only mirror and native clone, Gerrit, or tracker access is unavailable.
The verify_findings telemetry wiring child was scoped out and left open rather than force-closing past the open-children guard.
